evidence.note: New CI workflow: read-only permissions, pinned action majors, go-version-file from go.mod, runs npm test coverage gate; no secrets or pull_request_target exposure.
Shard-plan markdown replaced by a static explanatory section; contextprofile is still referenced by contextprofile.Markdown on the preceding line, so no dangling import in this hunk.

RealExec scrubs all GIT_* env, disables terminal prompts, external diff drivers, system config and pager; argument injection is bounded by ValidRef/ValidSHA plus --end-of-options on every ref-taking call.
RevParse pins to a 40-char sha via ^{commit} and rejects code!=0; IsAncestor relies on exit 1 being non-error in run(), which runEnv deliberately allows only for codes 0 and 1.
WorkTree uses a scratch GIT_INDEX_FILE in a MkdirTemp dir removed via defer, so the repo index is never mutated; write-tree output length-checked at 40.
Cut backs up to a rune start; indexing s[i] is safe because the branch only runs when len(s) > max >= 0.
Golden prompt fixture exercising brace and fence escaping in judge prompt rendering; data only, no executable content.
Golden prompt fixture for the match prompt with template-delimiter and stray-brace inputs; data only.
Golden regression test regenerates only under FSM_RUN_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 and otherwise compares the committed log and every prefix snapshot, including a count check.
Extensive table-driven validation coverage: reason+at asserted for ~60 invalid documents, reserved env names, cap boundaries, resolve/calibration errors, and cmd pinning/verification paths.
ResolveCmds/VerifyCmds tested with injected lookPath and hash fakes plus a pinned preimage fixture, covering mismatch/missing/appeared and symlink and irregular-file cases.

findings.note: Test robustness: TestGoldenPrefixes ignores bufio.Scanner errors (no sc.Err()/ws.Err() check) and indexes stored[:i+1] while iterating the snapshot file. If the snapshot file ever holds more lines than the log file (or the log scan aborts early on an over-long line), the test panics with an index-out-of-range instead of reporting a clean failure. Test-only, non-blocking.

evidence.note: stored[:i+1] is driven by the snapshot scanner, not by len(stored); neither scanner's Err() is checked.

findings.note: Style: asExit hand-rolls a type assertion on *exec.ExitError instead of errors.As, so a wrapped ExitError would be reported as a run failure rather than an exit code. Harmless for exec.Cmd.Run today, which returns the ExitError unwrapped.

evidence.note: asExit uses err.(*exec.ExitError) rather than errors.As.
